package main

import (
	"context"
	"log"
	"net"
	"net/http"
	"os"
	"os/signal"
	"syscall"
	"time"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/config"
	filestorageadapter "github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/infrastructure/filestorage"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/infrastructure/http/taskanswer"
	natsadapter "github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/infrastructure/messaging/nats"
	pgadapter "github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/infrastructure/persistence/postgres"
	httpadapter "github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/transport/http"
	adminhandlers "github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/transport/http/admin/v1/handlers"
	handlers "github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/transport/http/api/v1/handlers"
	privatehandlers "github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/transport/http/private/handlers"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/catalog"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/codestructuretype"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/composeconfig"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/contentaccess"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/course"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/examplerelation"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/generatedcourse"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/knowledgeidentity"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/lesson"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/lessonexample"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/lessonrelation"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/lessonrevision"
	moduleuc "github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/module"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/position"
	sectionuc "github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/section"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/tag"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/task"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/tech"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/usecase/techversion"
	"github.com/go-playground/validator/v10"
	"github.com/google/uuid"
	"github.com/nats-io/nats.go"
	"go.uber.org/zap"
)

type uuidGenerator struct{}

func (uuidGenerator) NewID() string { return uuid.NewString() }

type systemClock struct{}

func (systemClock) Now() time.Time { return time.Now().UTC() }

func main() {
	ctx := context.Background()
	if len(os.Args) == 2 {
		switch os.Args[1] {
		case migrateFreshCommand:
			os.Exit(runFreshMigrationsCommand(ctx))
		case provisionDiagnosticAssessmentFixtureCommand:
			os.Exit(runDiagnosticAssessmentFixtureCommand(ctx))
		}
	}

	logger, _ := zap.NewProduction()
	cfg, err := config.Load()
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("config error: %v", err)
	}

	pool, err := pgadapter.Connect(ctx, cfg.DatabaseURL)
	if err != nil {
		log.Fatalf("db error: %v", err)
	}
	defer pool.Close()
	if len(os.Args) == 2 && os.Args[1] == "provision-verification-fixture" {
		if err := runVerificationFixtureCommand(ctx, pool); err != nil {
			pool.Close()
			log.Print(err)
			os.Exit(2)
		}
		return
	}

	natsConn, _ := nats.Connect(cfg.NATSURL)
	defer func() {
		if natsConn != nil {
			if err := natsConn.Drain(); err != nil {
				log.Printf("nats drain error: %v", err)
			}
		}
	}()

	validator := validator.New()
	publisher := &natsadapter.Publisher{Conn: natsConn}
	taskAnswerClient := taskanswer.Client{
		BaseURL:       cfg.TaskAnswerServiceBaseURL,
		InternalToken: cfg.TaskAnswerServiceInternalToken,
	}
	fileStorageClient := filestorageadapter.Client{
		BaseURL: cfg.FileStorageServiceBaseURL,
	}

	courseRepo := pgadapter.CourseRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	courseOutlineRepo := pgadapter.CourseOutlineRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	catalogScopeRepo := pgadapter.CatalogScopeRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	contentAccessRepo := pgadapter.ContentAccessRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	contentAccessService := contentaccess.Service{Repository: contentAccessRepo, ReadAccess: contentAccessRepo}
	trackRepo := pgadapter.TrackRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	trackI18nRepo := pgadapter.TrackI18nRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	courseLevelRepo := pgadapter.CourseLevelRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	courseLevelI18nRepo := pgadapter.CourseLevelI18nRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	courseGroupRepo := pgadapter.CourseGroupRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	courseGroupI18nRepo := pgadapter.CourseGroupI18nRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	trackLevelRepo := pgadapter.TrackLevelRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	levelCourseGroupRepo := pgadapter.LevelCourseGroupRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	courseGroupCourseRepo := pgadapter.CourseGroupCourseRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	techRepo := pgadapter.TechRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	techVersionRepo := pgadapter.TechVersionRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	composeConfigRepo := pgadapter.ComposeConfigRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	courseI18nRepo := pgadapter.CourseI18nRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	i18nRepo := pgadapter.I18nRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	courseTechRepo := pgadapter.CourseTechRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	composeConfigTechRepo := pgadapter.ComposeConfigTechRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	courseTagRepo := pgadapter.CourseTagRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	positionRepo := pgadapter.PositionRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	positionTechRepo := pgadapter.PositionTechRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	positionCourseRepo := pgadapter.PositionCourseRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	tagRepo := pgadapter.TagRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	moduleRepo := pgadapter.ModuleRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	moduleI18nRepo := pgadapter.ModuleI18nRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	courseModuleRepo := pgadapter.CourseModuleRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	lessonRepo := pgadapter.LessonRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	lessonRelationRepo := pgadapter.LessonRelationRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	lessonExampleRepo := pgadapter.LessonExampleRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	lessonExampleRelationRepo := pgadapter.LessonExampleRelationRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	sectionLessonRepo := pgadapter.SectionLessonRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	lessonVersionRepo := pgadapter.LessonVersionRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	sectionRepo := pgadapter.SectionRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	sectionI18nRepo := pgadapter.SectionI18nRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	moduleSectionRepo := pgadapter.ModuleSectionRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	lessonI18nRepo := pgadapter.LessonI18nRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	knowledgeIdentityRepo := pgadapter.KnowledgeIdentityRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	generatedCourseRepo := pgadapter.GeneratedCourseRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	taskI18nRepo := pgadapter.TaskI18nRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	taskRepo := pgadapter.TaskRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	taskTestRepo := pgadapter.TaskTestRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	taskFileStorageRepo := pgadapter.TaskFileStorageRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	taskLearningTargetRepo := pgadapter.TaskLearningTargetRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	structureRepo := pgadapter.CodeStructureTypeRepoPG{Pool: pool}
	txManager := pgadapter.TxManagerPG{Pool: pool}

	createCourse := course.CreateCourse{
		Courses:   courseRepo,
		Publisher: publisher,
		Tx:        txManager,
	}
	updateCourse := course.UpdateCourse{
		Courses:   courseRepo,
		Lessons:   lessonRepo,
		Publisher: publisher,
		Tx:        txManager,
	}
	deleteCourse := course.DeleteCourse{Courses: courseRepo, Publisher: publisher}
	getCourse := course.GetCourse{Courses: courseRepo, CourseI18n: courseI18nRepo}
	listCourses := course.ListCourses{Courses: courseRepo}
	getCourseOutline := course.GetCourseOutline{Outlines: courseOutlineRepo, Access: contentAccessService}
	listPublicCatalogScopes := catalog.ListPublicScopes{Scopes: catalogScopeRepo}

	createTrackUC := catalog.CreateTrack{Tracks: trackRepo, TrackI18n: trackI18nRepo, I18n: i18nRepo, Tx: txManager}
	updateTrackUC := catalog.UpdateTrack{Tracks: trackRepo, TrackI18n: trackI18nRepo, I18n: i18nRepo, Tx: txManager}
	deleteTrackUC := catalog.DeleteTrack{Tracks: trackRepo}
	getTrackUC := catalog.GetTrack{Tracks: trackRepo, TrackI18n: trackI18nRepo}
	listTracksUC := catalog.ListTracks{Tracks: trackRepo}
	createCourseLevelUC := catalog.CreateCourseLevel{Levels: courseLevelRepo, LevelI18n: courseLevelI18nRepo, I18n: i18nRepo, Tx: txManager}
	updateCourseLevelUC := catalog.UpdateCourseLevel{Levels: courseLevelRepo, LevelI18n: courseLevelI18nRepo, I18n: i18nRepo, Tx: txManager}
	deleteCourseLevelUC := catalog.DeleteCourseLevel{Levels: courseLevelRepo}
	getCourseLevelUC := catalog.GetCourseLevel{Levels: courseLevelRepo, LevelI18n: courseLevelI18nRepo}
	listCourseLevelsUC := catalog.ListCourseLevels{Levels: courseLevelRepo, Tracks: trackRepo}
	createCourseGroupUC := catalog.CreateCourseGroup{Groups: courseGroupRepo, GroupI18n: courseGroupI18nRepo, I18n: i18nRepo, Tx: txManager}
	updateCourseGroupUC := catalog.UpdateCourseGroup{Groups: courseGroupRepo, GroupI18n: courseGroupI18nRepo, I18n: i18nRepo, Tx: txManager}
	deleteCourseGroupUC := catalog.DeleteCourseGroup{Groups: courseGroupRepo}
	getCourseGroupUC := catalog.GetCourseGroup{Groups: courseGroupRepo, GroupI18n: courseGroupI18nRepo}
	listCourseGroupsUC := catalog.ListCourseGroups{Groups: courseGroupRepo, Levels: courseLevelRepo}
	addTrackLevelUC := catalog.AddTrackLevel{Tracks: trackRepo, Levels: courseLevelRepo, TrackLevels: trackLevelRepo, Tx: txManager}
	deleteTrackLevelUC := catalog.DeleteTrackLevel{Tracks: trackRepo, Levels: courseLevelRepo, TrackLevels: trackLevelRepo, Tx: txManager}
	replaceTrackLevelsUC := catalog.ReplaceTrackLevels{Tracks: trackRepo, Levels: courseLevelRepo, TrackLevels: trackLevelRepo, Tx: txManager}
	addLevelCourseGroupUC := catalog.AddLevelCourseGroup{Levels: courseLevelRepo, Groups: courseGroupRepo, LevelCourseGroups: levelCourseGroupRepo, Tx: txManager}
	deleteLevelCourseGroupUC := catalog.DeleteLevelCourseGroup{Levels: courseLevelRepo, Groups: courseGroupRepo, LevelCourseGroups: levelCourseGroupRepo, Tx: txManager}
	replaceLevelCourseGroupsUC := catalog.ReplaceLevelCourseGroups{Levels: courseLevelRepo, Groups: courseGroupRepo, LevelCourseGroups: levelCourseGroupRepo, Tx: txManager}
	addCourseGroupCourseUC := catalog.AddCourseGroupCourse{Groups: courseGroupRepo, Courses: courseRepo, CourseGroupCourses: courseGroupCourseRepo, Tx: txManager}
	deleteCourseGroupCourseUC := catalog.DeleteCourseGroupCourse{Groups: courseGroupRepo, Courses: courseRepo, CourseGroupCourses: courseGroupCourseRepo, Tx: txManager}
	replaceCourseGroupCoursesUC := catalog.ReplaceCourseGroupCourses{Groups: courseGroupRepo, Courses: courseRepo, CourseGroupCourses: courseGroupCourseRepo, Tx: txManager}

	createModuleUC := moduleuc.CreateModule{Modules: moduleRepo, ModuleI18n: moduleI18nRepo, Techs: techRepo, I18n: i18nRepo, Tx: txManager}
	updateModuleUC := moduleuc.UpdateModule{Modules: moduleRepo, ModuleI18n: moduleI18nRepo, Techs: techRepo, I18n: i18nRepo, Tx: txManager}
	deleteModuleUC := moduleuc.DeleteModule{Modules: moduleRepo}
	getModuleUC := moduleuc.GetModule{Modules: moduleRepo, ModuleI18n: moduleI18nRepo}
	listModulesUC := moduleuc.ListModules{Modules: moduleRepo, Courses: courseRepo}
	addCourseModuleUC := course.AddCourseModule{Courses: courseRepo, Modules: moduleRepo, CourseModules: courseModuleRepo, Tx: txManager}
	replaceCourseModulesUC := course.ReplaceCourseModules{Courses: courseRepo, Modules: moduleRepo, CourseModules: courseModuleRepo, Tx: txManager}
	deleteCourseModuleUC := course.DeleteCourseModule{Courses: courseRepo, Modules: moduleRepo, CourseModules: courseModuleRepo, Tx: txManager}

	createSectionUC := sectionuc.CreateSection{Sections: sectionRepo, SectionI18n: sectionI18nRepo, Techs: techRepo, I18n: i18nRepo, Tx: txManager}
	updateSectionUC := sectionuc.UpdateSection{Sections: sectionRepo, SectionI18n: sectionI18nRepo, Techs: techRepo, I18n: i18nRepo, Tx: txManager}
	deleteSectionUC := sectionuc.DeleteSection{Sections: sectionRepo}
	getSectionUC := sectionuc.GetSection{Sections: sectionRepo, SectionI18n: sectionI18nRepo}
	listSectionsUC := sectionuc.ListSectionsByModule{Sections: sectionRepo, Modules: moduleRepo}
	addModuleSectionUC := moduleuc.AddModuleSection{Modules: moduleRepo, Sections: sectionRepo, ModuleSections: moduleSectionRepo, Tx: txManager}
	replaceModuleSectionsUC := moduleuc.ReplaceModuleSections{Modules: moduleRepo, Sections: sectionRepo, ModuleSections: moduleSectionRepo, Tx: txManager}
	deleteModuleSectionUC := moduleuc.DeleteModuleSection{Modules: moduleRepo, Sections: sectionRepo, ModuleSections: moduleSectionRepo, Tx: txManager}

	createLesson := lesson.CreateLesson{
		Lessons:        lessonRepo,
		LessonVersions: lessonVersionRepo,
		LessonI18n:     lessonI18nRepo,
		Tasks:          taskRepo,
		TechVersions:   techVersionRepo,
		ComposeConfigs: composeConfigRepo,
		Tx:             txManager,
	}
	updateLesson := lesson.UpdateLesson{
		Courses:        courseRepo,
		Lessons:        lessonRepo,
		LessonVersions: lessonVersionRepo,
		LessonI18n:     lessonI18nRepo,
		Tasks:          taskRepo,
		TechVersions:   techVersionRepo,
		ComposeConfigs: composeConfigRepo,
		Tx:             txManager,
	}
	deleteLesson := lesson.DeleteLesson{Lessons: lessonRepo}
	getLesson := lesson.GetLesson{Lessons: lessonRepo}
	lessonRevisionUC := lessonrevision.Definitions{Revisions: pgadapter.LessonRevisionRepoPG{Pool: pool}, Lessons: lessonRepo, Translations: lessonI18nRepo, Tasks: taskRepo, Tests: taskTestRepo, Files: taskFileStorageRepo, Examples: lessonExampleRepo, Tx: pgadapter.LessonRevisionTxPG{Pool: pool}}
	getTeacherLessonContext := lesson.GetTeacherContext{Lessons: lessonRepo, LessonI18n: lessonI18nRepo}
	getLessonMaterials := lesson.GetLessonMaterials{
		Lessons:          lessonRepo,
		LessonRelations:  lessonRelationRepo,
		Examples:         lessonExampleRepo,
		ExampleRelations: lessonExampleRelationRepo,
		Tasks:            taskRepo,
		TaskTests:        taskTestRepo,
		Access:           contentAccessService,
	}
	listLessons := lesson.ListLessonsByCourse{Courses: courseRepo, Modules: moduleRepo, Sections: sectionRepo, Lessons: lessonRepo}
	replaceLessonRelationsUC := lessonrelation.ReplaceLessonRelations{Lessons: lessonRepo, Relations: lessonRelationRepo, Tx: txManager}
	listLessonRelationsUC := lessonrelation.ListLessonRelations{Lessons: lessonRepo, Relations: lessonRelationRepo}
	deleteLessonRelationUC := lessonrelation.DeleteLessonRelation{Relations: lessonRelationRepo}
	replaceLessonExamplesUC := lessonexample.ReplaceLessonExamples{Lessons: lessonRepo, Examples: lessonExampleRepo, I18n: i18nRepo, Tx: txManager}
	listLessonExamplesUC := lessonexample.ListLessonExamples{Lessons: lessonRepo, Examples: lessonExampleRepo}
	deleteLessonExampleUC := lessonexample.DeleteLessonExample{Examples: lessonExampleRepo}
	replaceExampleRelationsUC := examplerelation.ReplaceExampleRelations{Examples: lessonExampleRepo, Relations: lessonExampleRelationRepo, Tx: txManager}
	listExampleRelationsUC := examplerelation.ListExampleRelations{Examples: lessonExampleRepo, Relations: lessonExampleRelationRepo}
	deleteExampleRelationUC := examplerelation.DeleteExampleRelation{Relations: lessonExampleRelationRepo}
	addSectionLessonUC := sectionuc.AddSectionLesson{Sections: sectionRepo, Lessons: lessonRepo, SectionLessons: sectionLessonRepo, Tx: txManager}
	replaceSectionLessonsUC := sectionuc.ReplaceSectionLessons{Sections: sectionRepo, Lessons: lessonRepo, SectionLessons: sectionLessonRepo, Tx: txManager}
	deleteSectionLessonUC := sectionuc.DeleteSectionLesson{Sections: sectionRepo, Lessons: lessonRepo, SectionLessons: sectionLessonRepo, Tx: txManager}

	createTaskUC := task.CreateTask{Tasks: taskRepo, Lessons: lessonRepo, TaskI18n: taskI18nRepo, TaskTests: taskTestRepo, TaskFiles: taskFileStorageRepo, LearningTargets: taskLearningTargetRepo, Publisher: publisher, StructureRes: structureRepo, ComposeConfigs: composeConfigRepo, Tx: txManager}
	updateTaskUC := task.UpdateTask{Tasks: taskRepo, Lessons: lessonRepo, TaskI18n: taskI18nRepo, TaskTests: taskTestRepo, TaskFiles: taskFileStorageRepo, LearningTargets: taskLearningTargetRepo, Publisher: publisher, ComposeConfigs: composeConfigRepo, StructureRes: structureRepo, Tx: txManager}
	uploadStarterArchiveUC := task.UploadStarterArchive{
		Tasks:     taskRepo,
		TaskFiles: taskFileStorageRepo,
		Uploader:  fileStorageClient,
		Activator: fileStorageClient,
		Tx:        txManager,
	}
	deleteTaskUC := task.DeleteTask{Tasks: taskRepo, Publisher: publisher}
	getTaskUC := task.GetTask{Tasks: taskRepo, Structures: structureRepo}
	getTaskDetailsUC := task.GetTaskDetails{Tasks: taskRepo, TaskTests: taskTestRepo, TaskFiles: taskFileStorageRepo, LearningTargets: taskLearningTargetRepo, Structures: structureRepo}
	getInternalCourseStructureUC := task.GetInternalCourseStructure{Lessons: lessonRepo, Tasks: taskRepo}
	getInternalCompletedLessonsUC := task.GetInternalCompletedLessons{Lessons: lessonRepo, Tasks: taskRepo, Progress: taskAnswerClient}
	listTasksUC := task.ListTasksByLesson{Tasks: taskRepo}

	createTechUC := tech.CreateTech{Techs: techRepo}
	getTechUC := tech.GetTechByLabel{Techs: techRepo}
	getTechByIDUC := tech.GetTechByID{Techs: techRepo}
	updateTechUC := tech.UpdateTech{Techs: techRepo}
	deleteTechUC := tech.DeleteTech{Techs: techRepo}
	listTechUC := tech.ListTechs{Techs: techRepo}
	listTechVersionUC := techversion.ListTechVersions{TechVersions: techVersionRepo}
	createTechVersionUC := techversion.CreateTechVersion{TechVersions: techVersionRepo, Techs: techRepo}
	updateTechVersionUC := techversion.UpdateTechVersion{TechVersions: techVersionRepo}
	deleteTechVersionUC := techversion.DeleteTechVersion{TechVersions: techVersionRepo}
	createTagUC := tag.CreateTag{Tags: tagRepo}
	getTagByIDUC := tag.GetTagByID{Tags: tagRepo}
	updateTagUC := tag.UpdateTag{Tags: tagRepo}
	deleteTagUC := tag.DeleteTag{Tags: tagRepo}
	listTagUC := tag.ListTags{Tags: tagRepo}
	createComposeConfigUC := composeconfig.CreateComposeConfig{ComposeConfigs: composeConfigRepo, ComposeConfigTechs: composeConfigTechRepo, Tx: txManager}
	getComposeConfigUC := composeconfig.GetComposeConfig{ComposeConfigs: composeConfigRepo, ComposeConfigTechs: composeConfigTechRepo}
	updateComposeConfigUC := composeconfig.UpdateComposeConfig{ComposeConfigs: composeConfigRepo, ComposeConfigTechs: composeConfigTechRepo, Tx: txManager}
	listComposeConfigUC := composeconfig.ListComposeConfigs{ComposeConfigs: composeConfigRepo, ComposeConfigTechs: composeConfigTechRepo}
	deleteComposeConfigUC := composeconfig.DeleteComposeConfig{ComposeConfigs: composeConfigRepo}
	upsertCourseI18nUC := course.UpsertCourseI18n{Courses: courseRepo, CourseI18n: courseI18nRepo, I18n: i18nRepo, Tx: txManager}
	deleteCourseI18nUC := course.DeleteCourseI18n{CourseI18n: courseI18nRepo}
	listI18nUC := course.ListI18n{I18n: i18nRepo}
	listCourseI18nUC := course.ListCourseI18n{Courses: courseRepo, CourseI18n: courseI18nRepo}
	updateCourseTagsUC := course.UpdateCourseTags{Courses: courseRepo, Tags: courseTagRepo, Tx: txManager}
	updateCourseTechsUC := course.UpdateCourseTechs{Courses: courseRepo, Techs: courseTechRepo, Tx: txManager}
	createPositionUC := position.CreatePosition{Positions: positionRepo}
	getPositionUC := position.GetPosition{Positions: positionRepo, PositionTechs: positionTechRepo, PositionCourses: positionCourseRepo}
	updatePositionUC := position.UpdatePosition{Positions: positionRepo}
	deletePositionUC := position.DeletePosition{Positions: positionRepo}
	listPositionUC := position.ListPositions{Positions: positionRepo, PositionTechs: positionTechRepo, PositionCourses: positionCourseRepo}
	updatePositionTechsUC := position.UpdatePositionTechs{Positions: positionRepo, Techs: positionTechRepo, Tx: txManager}
	updatePositionCoursesUC := position.UpdatePositionCourses{Positions: positionRepo, Courses: positionCourseRepo, Tx: txManager}
	createCodeStructureTypeUC := codestructuretype.CreateCodeStructureType{Structures: structureRepo}
	getCodeStructureTypeUC := codestructuretype.GetCodeStructureType{Structures: structureRepo}
	updateCodeStructureTypeUC := codestructuretype.UpdateCodeStructureType{Structures: structureRepo}
	deleteCodeStructureTypeUC := codestructuretype.DeleteCodeStructureType{Structures: structureRepo}
	listCodeStructureTypesUC := codestructuretype.ListCodeStructureTypes{Structures: structureRepo}
	resolveCourseLessonBindingsUC := knowledgeidentity.ResolveCourseLessonBindings{Bindings: knowledgeIdentityRepo}
	ensureGeneratedCourseUC := generatedcourse.Ensure{Revisions: lessonRevisionUC,
		Generated: generatedCourseRepo, Courses: courseRepo, CourseI18n: courseI18nRepo,
		Modules: moduleRepo, ModuleI18n: moduleI18nRepo, CourseModules: courseModuleRepo,
		Sections: sectionRepo, SectionI18n: sectionI18nRepo, ModuleSections: moduleSectionRepo,
		Lessons: lessonRepo, LessonI18n: lessonI18nRepo, SectionLessons: sectionLessonRepo,
		Examples: lessonExampleRepo, Tasks: taskRepo, TaskI18n: taskI18nRepo,
		TaskTargets: taskLearningTargetRepo, StructureTypes: structureRepo,
		I18n: i18nRepo, Tx: txManager, Publisher: publisher, IDs: uuidGenerator{}, Clock: systemClock{},
	}

	taskHandler := &handlers.TaskHandler{
		Validator:    validator,
		GetUC:        getTaskUC,
		GetDetailsUC: getTaskDetailsUC,
		ListUC:       listTasksUC,
		Access:       contentAccessService,
	}
	lessonHandler := &handlers.LessonHandler{Validator: validator, GetUC: getLesson, ListUC: listLessons, MaterialsUC: getLessonMaterials, Access: contentAccessService}
	lessonRelationsHandler := &handlers.LessonRelationsHandler{ListUC: listLessonRelationsUC, Access: contentAccessService}
	lessonExamplesHandler := &handlers.LessonExamplesHandler{ListUC: listLessonExamplesUC, Access: contentAccessService}
	exampleRelationsHandler := &handlers.ExampleRelationsHandler{ListUC: listExampleRelationsUC, Access: contentAccessService}
	courseHandler := &handlers.CourseHandler{Validator: validator, Logger: logger, GetUC: getCourse, ListUC: listCourses, ScopeListUC: listPublicCatalogScopes, OutlineUC: getCourseOutline}
	trackHandler := &handlers.TrackHandler{Validator: validator, GetUC: getTrackUC, ListUC: listTracksUC}
	courseLevelHandler := &handlers.CourseLevelHandler{Validator: validator, GetUC: getCourseLevelUC, ListUC: listCourseLevelsUC}
	courseGroupHandler := &handlers.CourseGroupHandler{Validator: validator, GetUC: getCourseGroupUC, ListUC: listCourseGroupsUC}
	moduleHandler := &handlers.ModuleHandler{Validator: validator, GetUC: getModuleUC, ListUC: listModulesUC, Access: contentAccessService}
	sectionHandler := &handlers.SectionHandler{Validator: validator, GetUC: getSectionUC, ListUC: listSectionsUC, Access: contentAccessService}
	positionHandler := &handlers.PositionHandler{
		Validator: validator,
		GetUC:     getPositionUC,
		ListUC:    listPositionUC,
	}
	adminTaskHandler := &adminhandlers.TaskHandler{
		Validator:                     validator,
		CreateUC:                      createTaskUC,
		UpdateUC:                      updateTaskUC,
		UploadStarterArchiveUC:        uploadStarterArchiveUC,
		DeleteUC:                      deleteTaskUC,
		GetUC:                         getTaskUC,
		GetDetailsUC:                  getTaskDetailsUC,
		ListUC:                        listTasksUC,
		GetInternalCourseStructureUC:  getInternalCourseStructureUC,
		GetInternalCompletedLessonsUC: getInternalCompletedLessonsUC,
		Access:                        contentAccessService,
	}
	adminLessonHandler := &adminhandlers.LessonHandler{RevisionsUC: lessonRevisionUC, Validator: validator, CreateUC: createLesson, UpdateUC: updateLesson, DeleteUC: deleteLesson, GetUC: getLesson, ListUC: listLessons, MaterialsUC: getLessonMaterials, Access: contentAccessService}
	adminLessonRelationsHandler := &adminhandlers.LessonRelationsHandler{Validator: validator, ReplaceUC: replaceLessonRelationsUC, ListUC: listLessonRelationsUC, DeleteUC: deleteLessonRelationUC, Access: contentAccessService}
	adminLessonExamplesHandler := &adminhandlers.LessonExamplesHandler{Validator: validator, ReplaceUC: replaceLessonExamplesUC, ListUC: listLessonExamplesUC, DeleteUC: deleteLessonExampleUC, Access: contentAccessService}
	adminExampleRelationsHandler := &adminhandlers.ExampleRelationsHandler{Validator: validator, ReplaceUC: replaceExampleRelationsUC, ListUC: listExampleRelationsUC, DeleteUC: deleteExampleRelationUC, Access: contentAccessService}
	adminCourseHandler := &adminhandlers.CourseHandler{Validator: validator, Logger: logger, CreateUC: createCourse, UpdateUC: updateCourse, DeleteUC: deleteCourse, GetUC: getCourse, ListUC: listCourses, ScopeListUC: listPublicCatalogScopes, OutlineUC: getCourseOutline}
	adminTrackHandler := &adminhandlers.TrackHandler{Validator: validator, CreateUC: createTrackUC, UpdateUC: updateTrackUC, DeleteUC: deleteTrackUC, GetUC: getTrackUC, ListUC: listTracksUC}
	adminCourseLevelHandler := &adminhandlers.CourseLevelHandler{Validator: validator, CreateUC: createCourseLevelUC, UpdateUC: updateCourseLevelUC, DeleteUC: deleteCourseLevelUC, GetUC: getCourseLevelUC, ListUC: listCourseLevelsUC}
	adminCourseGroupHandler := &adminhandlers.CourseGroupHandler{Validator: validator, CreateUC: createCourseGroupUC, UpdateUC: updateCourseGroupUC, DeleteUC: deleteCourseGroupUC, GetUC: getCourseGroupUC, ListUC: listCourseGroupsUC}
	adminTrackRelationsHandler := &adminhandlers.TrackRelationsHandler{Validator: validator, AddLevelUC: addTrackLevelUC, DeleteLevelUC: deleteTrackLevelUC, ReplaceUC: replaceTrackLevelsUC}
	adminLevelRelationsHandler := &adminhandlers.LevelRelationsHandler{Validator: validator, AddGroupUC: addLevelCourseGroupUC, DeleteGroupUC: deleteLevelCourseGroupUC, ReplaceUC: replaceLevelCourseGroupsUC}
	adminCourseGroupRelationsHandler := &adminhandlers.CourseGroupRelationsHandler{Validator: validator, AddCourseUC: addCourseGroupCourseUC, DeleteCourseUC: deleteCourseGroupCourseUC, ReplaceUC: replaceCourseGroupCoursesUC}
	adminModuleHandler := &adminhandlers.ModuleHandler{Validator: validator, CreateUC: createModuleUC, UpdateUC: updateModuleUC, DeleteUC: deleteModuleUC, GetUC: getModuleUC, ListUC: listModulesUC, Access: contentAccessService}
	adminModuleRelationsHandler := &adminhandlers.ModuleRelationsHandler{Validator: validator, AddSectionUC: addModuleSectionUC, ReplaceSectionsUC: replaceModuleSectionsUC, DeleteSectionUC: deleteModuleSectionUC}
	adminSectionHandler := &adminhandlers.SectionHandler{Validator: validator, CreateUC: createSectionUC, UpdateUC: updateSectionUC, DeleteUC: deleteSectionUC, GetUC: getSectionUC, ListUC: listSectionsUC, Access: contentAccessService}
	adminSectionRelationsHandler := &adminhandlers.SectionRelationsHandler{Validator: validator, AddLessonUC: addSectionLessonUC, ReplaceLessonsUC: replaceSectionLessonsUC, DeleteLessonUC: deleteSectionLessonUC}
	adminTechHandler := &adminhandlers.TechHandler{
		Validator: validator,
		CreateUC:  createTechUC,
		GetUC:     getTechUC,
		GetByIDUC: getTechByIDUC,
		UpdateUC:  updateTechUC,
		DeleteUC:  deleteTechUC,
		ListUC:    listTechUC,
	}
	adminTechVersionHandler := &adminhandlers.TechVersionHandler{
		Validator: validator,
		CreateUC:  createTechVersionUC,
		UpdateUC:  updateTechVersionUC,
		DeleteUC:  deleteTechVersionUC,
		ListUC:    listTechVersionUC,
	}
	adminTagHandler := &adminhandlers.TagHandler{
		Validator: validator,
		CreateUC:  createTagUC,
		GetByIDUC: getTagByIDUC,
		UpdateUC:  updateTagUC,
		DeleteUC:  deleteTagUC,
		ListUC:    listTagUC,
	}
	adminComposeConfigHandler := &adminhandlers.ComposeConfigHandler{
		Validator: validator,
		CreateUC:  createComposeConfigUC,
		GetUC:     getComposeConfigUC,
		UpdateUC:  updateComposeConfigUC,
		ListUC:    listComposeConfigUC,
		DeleteUC:  deleteComposeConfigUC,
	}
	adminCourseI18nHandler := &adminhandlers.CourseI18nHandler{
		Validator:      validator,
		UpsertUC:       upsertCourseI18nUC,
		DeleteUC:       deleteCourseI18nUC,
		ListUC:         listI18nUC,
		ListByCourseUC: listCourseI18nUC,
	}
	adminCourseRelationsHandler := &adminhandlers.CourseRelationsHandler{Validator: validator, UpdateTagsUC: updateCourseTagsUC, UpdateTechsUC: updateCourseTechsUC, AddModuleUC: addCourseModuleUC, ReplaceModulesUC: replaceCourseModulesUC, DeleteModuleUC: deleteCourseModuleUC}
	adminPositionHandler := &adminhandlers.PositionHandler{
		Validator: validator,
		CreateUC:  createPositionUC,
		GetUC:     getPositionUC,
		UpdateUC:  updatePositionUC,
		DeleteUC:  deletePositionUC,
		ListUC:    listPositionUC,
	}
	adminPositionRelationsHandler := &adminhandlers.PositionRelationsHandler{
		Validator:       validator,
		UpdateTechsUC:   updatePositionTechsUC,
		UpdateCoursesUC: updatePositionCoursesUC,
	}
	adminCodeStructureTypeHandler := &adminhandlers.CodeStructureTypeHandler{
		Validator: validator,
		CreateUC:  createCodeStructureTypeUC,
		GetUC:     getCodeStructureTypeUC,
		UpdateUC:  updateCodeStructureTypeUC,
		DeleteUC:  deleteCodeStructureTypeUC,
		ListUC:    listCodeStructureTypesUC,
	}
	adminKnowledgeImportBatchHandler := &adminhandlers.KnowledgeImportBatchHandler{Tx: txManager}
	privateTaskHandler := &privatehandlers.TaskHandler{
		GetDetailsUC:                  getTaskDetailsUC,
		GetInternalCourseStructureUC:  getInternalCourseStructureUC,
		GetInternalCompletedLessonsUC: getInternalCompletedLessonsUC,
	}
	privateLessonHandler := &privatehandlers.LessonHandler{RevisionsUC: lessonRevisionUC, GetUC: getLesson, TeacherContextUC: getTeacherLessonContext}
	privateKnowledgeIdentityHandler := &privatehandlers.KnowledgeIdentityHandler{ResolveUC: resolveCourseLessonBindingsUC}
	privateGeneratedCourseHandler := &privatehandlers.GeneratedCourseHandler{Ensure: ensureGeneratedCourseUC}

	router := httpadapter.NewRouter(httpadapter.RouterDependencies{
		CourseHandler:                    courseHandler,
		TrackHandler:                     trackHandler,
		CourseLevelHandler:               courseLevelHandler,
		CourseGroupHandler:               courseGroupHandler,
		ModuleHandler:                    moduleHandler,
		SectionHandler:                   sectionHandler,
		LessonHandler:                    lessonHandler,
		LessonRelationsHandler:           lessonRelationsHandler,
		LessonExamplesHandler:            lessonExamplesHandler,
		ExampleRelationsHandler:          exampleRelationsHandler,
		TaskHandler:                      taskHandler,
		PositionHandler:                  positionHandler,
		AdminCourseHandler:               adminCourseHandler,
		AdminTrackHandler:                adminTrackHandler,
		AdminCourseLevelHandler:          adminCourseLevelHandler,
		AdminCourseGroupHandler:          adminCourseGroupHandler,
		AdminTrackRelationsHandler:       adminTrackRelationsHandler,
		AdminLevelRelationsHandler:       adminLevelRelationsHandler,
		AdminCourseGroupRelationsHandler: adminCourseGroupRelationsHandler,
		AdminModuleHandler:               adminModuleHandler,
		AdminModuleRelationsHandler:      adminModuleRelationsHandler,
		AdminSectionHandler:              adminSectionHandler,
		AdminSectionRelationsHandler:     adminSectionRelationsHandler,
		AdminLessonHandler:               adminLessonHandler,
		AdminLessonRelationsHandler:      adminLessonRelationsHandler,
		AdminLessonExamplesHandler:       adminLessonExamplesHandler,
		AdminExampleRelationsHandler:     adminExampleRelationsHandler,
		AdminTaskHandler:                 adminTaskHandler,
		AdminTechHandler:                 adminTechHandler,
		AdminTechVersionHandler:          adminTechVersionHandler,
		AdminTagHandler:                  adminTagHandler,
		AdminComposeConfigHandler:        adminComposeConfigHandler,
		AdminCourseI18nHandler:           adminCourseI18nHandler,
		AdminCourseRelationsHandler:      adminCourseRelationsHandler,
		AdminPositionHandler:             adminPositionHandler,
		AdminPositionRelationsHandler:    adminPositionRelationsHandler,
		AdminCodeStructureTypeHandler:    adminCodeStructureTypeHandler,
		AdminKnowledgeImportBatchHandler: adminKnowledgeImportBatchHandler,
		PrivateTaskHandler:               privateTaskHandler,
		PrivateLessonHandler:             privateLessonHandler,
		PrivateKnowledgeIdentityHandler:  privateKnowledgeIdentityHandler,
		PrivateGeneratedCourseHandler:    privateGeneratedCourseHandler,
		Validator:                        validator,
		InternalToken:                    cfg.InternalAPIToken,
		LearningPlannerInternalToken:     cfg.LearningPlannerInternalToken,
		DiagnosticCatalogInternalToken:   cfg.DiagnosticCatalogInternalToken,
	})
	adminKnowledgeImportBatchHandler.Dispatch = router

	srv := &http.Server{Addr: net.JoinHostPort(cfg.HTTPHost, cfg.HTTPPort), Handler: router}

	go func() {
		logger.Info("starting http server", zap.String("port", cfg.HTTPPort))
		if err := srv.ListenAndServe(); err != nil && err != http.ErrServerClosed {
			logger.Fatal("http server error", zap.Error(err))
		}
	}()

	stop := make(chan os.Signal, 1)
	signal.Notify(stop, syscall.SIGINT, syscall.SIGTERM)
	<-stop
	logger.Info("shutting down")
	ctxShutdown, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), time.Duration(cfg.ShutdownTimeout)*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	if err := srv.Shutdown(ctxShutdown); err != nil {
		logger.Error("shutdown error", zap.Error(err))
	}
}
